item.title: Rear naked choke
item.description: RNC is initiated from a back position with a Seatbelt grip Get hooks in: Goal is to solidify your back position using legs as hooks.

item.title: Straight ankle lock
item.description: Description Most commonplace leg attack that surprisingly is legal for all belts.

item.title: Run away
item.description: From Single leg if you can elevate and grab the opponents ankle you can contain it in your armpit and face away from your opponent.

item.title: Single leg
item.description: Description Fairly basic Takedown from Standing often preceded by Shooting or just exposing the leg of opponent by puling them towards you.

item.title: Gameplan
item.description: General Goal of this page is to outline a plan of what to do in different scenarios.

item.title: Mermaid
item.description: Similar to the squishing both legs together when opponent has both legs inside in a Butterfly guard or similar.

item.title: Butterfly guard
item.description: General Simple Open guard where you have both of your ankles on inside position and you are controlling the opponents thighs with your ankles.

item.title: High crotch
item.description: Takedown from Single leg where you get closer to opponent and have the arms very close to opponents crotch.

item.title: Baseball choke
item.description: Gi Choke where you have a underhook on possibly turtling opponent and you decide to feed your shirt to your underhook.
